verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the REST API, language SDKs, a Postman collection, llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec. These are developer building blocks or adjacent tooling, not an official command-line interface, and they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
